title: A2A (Agent2Agent protocol): how agents hand tasks to other agents, and where you can stop them
summary: Hold: the package-blocking row sends administrators to an agent-level control, which Microsoft explicitly distinguishes from blocking a whole package. The API is correct, but the UI must point to the package control under Agents > Tools > Plugins. Several smaller source qualifications also need correction.
